{{Quote|I miss her very much, but I can't get her involved with this.|[[Kyran Silene]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Bandor|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Madison Silene''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My husband has gone missing. I need help to find him.|Madison Silene, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SR" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Madison Silene lived in [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. She was the wife of [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Kyran Silene]] and she was friend with [[Angela]].<ref name="SWG:SR" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> her husband disappeared suddenly.<ref name="SWG:SR" /> She ignored that a group of [[Corellian slavers]] operating near Tyrena captured Kyran and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] him.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> Despite [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Alana Walden]] of the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] was investigating similar disappearances on Corellia,<ref name="web">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66901&resource=features|text=Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives}}</ref> Madison Silene contacted a spacer who had previously helped her friend Angela to find her missing husband.<ref name="SWG:SR" /> The spacer agreed to help Madison and interrogated [[Bandor Mokk]], a new and suspect friend of Kyran Silene. The man revealed that Kyran Silene was captured by slavers but managed to escape.<ref name="SWG:TtB" /> The spacer traveled to a camp outside Tyrena where gathered a group of escaped slave. Kyran explained that he could not come back until the situation was resolved. After the spacer attacked the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] and revealed its existence to the CorSec,<ref name="SWG:IE">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Incriminating Evidence" on Corellia</ref> Kyran Silene eventually returned to a normal life with Madison.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Madison Silene was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Madison Silene was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
